players.product: enterprise PCIe Gen5 SSD controllers for hyperscaler SSDs

quarterly_data.signal: New supply contract: enterprise SSD controllers for an undisclosed overseas NAND flash memory manufacturer (FADU has performed same-type contracts with it in the past three years; name, revenue and relationship withheld at the counterparty's request for trade secrecy, disclosure deferred to 2027-02-01). PO received 2026-08-11; term 2026-08-11 to 2027-02-01 (the end date is the product delivery date and may change by agreement with the customer); outsourced production, overseas supply; no advance payment, payment within 30 days of delivery.
